KeysToEntries.Manktongue.Intro.Default: Nice day fer a walk, innit?
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.Opening.1: Got a moment for ol' Manktongue?
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.Opening.2: Manktongue's got an opper-toonity for ya. It'll blow yer bronze boots off.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.Opening.3: Nice, nice. Here's the deal-io. Ol' Manktongue found a message in a bottle. It's an advert-eye-cement from da mainland.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.Opening.4: Manktongue try to make da machine described in da advert-eye-cement, but fings not go to plan.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.Opening.5: But now YOU here. And YOU be Manktongue's bizness partner. YOU help Manktongue make da machine.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.Opening.6: Have a look at da advert-inna-bottle next to me. Talk to me after, an' we can work out terms.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.QuestComplete.2: Oi oi! Good to see me ol' bizness partner again!
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.QuestComplete.3: What can ol' Manktongue do for you?
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.QuestComplete.4: It part of ol' Manktongue now.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.QuestComplete.5: It comes wiv da territory. I am a pie-in-ear, af'er all.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.QuestComplete.6: Well, it's good to see ya again.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.QuestComplete.7: Look me up on Link Tin.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.ReturnWithoutAdvert: You deaf or summat? Read da advert-inna-bottle next to me.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.ReadAdvert.1: Good good. Now we can talk 'bout Ava's Accoo...
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.ReadAdvert.2: Accooma latte... Accooma llama... Accooma matata...
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.ReadAdvert.4: This is how we gonna make da Arrow Grabba. Step one: you make da Arrow Grabba.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.ReadAdvert.6: Go get all da in-greedy-yums mentioned in da advert, 'an bring them back to me. I'll be takin' a load off.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.ReadAdvert.7: Before ya go, do ya wanna ask ol' Manktongue anyfink?
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.AlreadyReadAdvert.1: Ah, seems you've already read da advert.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.GotIngredients.1: Oi oi! Looks like ya got all da in-greedy-yums for the Arrow Grabba. Want me to work my magic?
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.GotIngredients.2: Okay. A little glue here. A little elbow grease there. Ta-da! Made you one Arrow grabba!
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.GotIngredients.3: I'm gonna come clean to ya: I may have con-figgered da Arrow Grabba a tad.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.GotIngredients.4: Some of da arrows are gonna come to ol' Manktongue. Call it da Manktongue Tax. Dat's biz-ness for ya.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.GotIngredients.5: But I fink you will be pleased, none-da-less.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.Reward.1: Go forth! Fire dem arrows, grab dem arrows! And who knows? Maybe we can come to anuvver deal in the foo-ture?
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.NoRoom.1: Oi oi, you ain't got room for da Arrow Grabba!
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.NoRoom.2: Come back when you got a single space to carry it.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.IngredientsChoice.1: Need help with da in-greedy-yums for the Arrow Grabber?
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.IngredientsChoice.2: So, full diss-closure: Manktongue got as far as findin' an undead chicken.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.IngredientsChoice.3: Thing is, Manktongue got da order of opper-ations wrong and axey-dentally magnetised it.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.IngredientsChoice.4: Undead chicken is headin' due north. Probby got stuck to somethin' metal. If you head north, I reckon you'll find da chicken in no time.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.IngredientsChoice.5: Unless it's been eaten by a Garou, and den you're looking for a magnetised, undead Garou.
KeysToEntries.Player.Ingredients.Magnet: Ask about the Magnetised Iron Bar
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.IngredientsChoice.7: Bring five law runes and an iron bar to Pulpknuckle up da stairs and he'll do it for ya.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.IngredientsChoice.8: Advert is vague about undead twigs, right? Manktongue plan to give dat feedback to Ava when he meets her.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.IngredientsChoice.9: Only place Ol' Manktongue as seen dem is in Bloodblight Swamp. Near a tree with glowy orange stuff on it.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.IngredientsChoice.10: It's an 'orrible place. You will need to find a tree wiv glowing orange warty bits all over it.
KeysToEntries.Player.Ingredients.No: I've got all the information I need
KeysToEntries.Advert.Text.1: To all inventors! Rather than patent or make money from my invention - AVA'S ACCUMULATOR - I have made the decision to make it freely available.
KeysToEntries.Advert.Text.2: This invention will offer a chance to recover any metal-based arrows that are lost when firing a ranged weapon.
KeysToEntries.Advert.Text.3: Components:1 x Undead Chicken, 1 x Magnetised Iron Bar and 1 x Undead Twig Bundle.
KeysToEntries.Default.NoItemSpace: You have no space in your inventory.
KeysToEntries.Pulpknuckle.Default.1: I like hitting fings, I do.
KeysToEntries.Pulpknuckle.Magnet.1: 'Ello hooman. Got somefin' you need whacked?
KeysToEntries.Player.Pulpknuckle.Choice.1: Could you smith me a magnetised iron bar?
KeysToEntries.Pulpknuckle.Magnet.NoItems.1: For whacky magnet you'll need one iron bar and five law runes.
KeysToEntries.Pulpknuckle.Magnet.3: Bish bash bosh. One extra strong magnet.
KeysToEntries.Pulpknuckle.Magnet.4: Trust me. Don't eat it. Ain't worth it.
KeysToEntries.Pulpknuckle.Magnet.NoSpace.1: You got no space,  grotface. Huh-huh, I rhymed.
KeysToEntries.Player.Chicken.NotStarted.1: Wait - is that a chicken stuck to a cliff face?
KeysToEntries.Player.Chicken.PickUp.1: The undead magnetised chicken tries to nibble your neck as you bundle it into your bag.
KeysToEntries.Player.Chicken.NoSpace.1: You would grab the undead magnetised chicken, but you have no space in your inventory.
KeysToEntries.Players.UndeadTwigs.NotStarted.1: What an odd-looking bundle of twigs.
KeysToEntries.Player.UndeadTwigs.PickUp.1: The bundle of undead twigs moans as you stash them in your backpack.
KeysToEntries.Player.UndeadTwigs.NoSpace.1: You would pick up the bundle of undead twigs, but you have no space in your inventory.
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.NotYet.1: Cool beans. Let ol' Manktongue know when you ready for da next step.
KeysToEntries.Advertinnabottle.1: An advert that details how to make an 'Ava's Accumulator'.
KeysToEntries.UndeadChicken.Description: Manktongue asked for an Undead Chicken.
KeysToEntries.UndeadTwigs.Description: Manktongue needs these undead twigs to make Ava's Accumulator.
KeysToEntries.QuestObjective.1: Read the Advert-Inna-Bottle next to Manktongue
KeysToEntries.QuestObjective.3: Gather an undead chicken, magnetised iron bar and undead twigs, and bring them to Manktongue
KeysToEntries.Manktongue.Name: Manktongue
KeysToEntries.Pulpknuckle.Name: Pulpknuckle
